column2: Retain Solomon's introduction and the Lord's dwelling in thick darkness. Two display lines separate the narrative introduction from the selected poetic declaration; no sun or Book of Song clause is imported from Kings.

Retain the house for Thy name, holy to Thee and ready for enduring dwelling. Two lines follow the selected poetic clauses. Direct divine address begins here after the third-person reference in verse 1.
Retain the king turning his face, blessing all the assembly and the assembly standing. The repeated all-Israel assembly description remains rather than being removed as redundant.
Retain blessing, speech by God's mouth and fulfillment by His plural hands. The following quotation is God's speech recalled by Solomon; the body imagery is not flattened to promise kept.
Retain the historical absence of a selected city and a selected man since the exodus. Both negatives remain before the two positive choices in the next verse.
Retain Jerusalem chosen for the name and David chosen over Israel. The paired choices answer the paired negatives without substituting Solomon for David.
Retain the intention upon David's heart to build for the name of Israel's God. The narrative still reports David's intention, not a construction accomplished by him.
Retain the repeated upon-your-heart expression and divine commendation of the intention. Ordinary your/you is correct inside God's address to David.
Retain the prohibition for David and his bodily descendant from his loins as builder. The emphatic he is represented, and no name Solomon is newly supplied inside this promise.
Retain the Lord establishing His word, Solomon's succession and throne, and his construction for God's name. These are reported fulfillments, not converted into future promises.
Retain the ark placed there and the Lord's covenant with Israel within it. Do not append the exodus date clause from a longer parallel account.
Retain standing before altar and assembly and spreading hands. The following explanation of the bronze base is not inserted into this shorter unit.

Retain the bronze base, five by five by three cubits, middle of the court, standing, kneeling and hands spread heavenward. Both successive postures remain rather than being treated as a contradiction.
Retain no comparable god in heaven or earth, covenant and mercy kept for wholehearted servants. The prayer consistently addresses God with Thee/Thy while the servants remain third person.

Retain the things kept for David, repeated speech with mouth and fulfillment with hands as on this day. Saying them is inherited connective treatment of the selected participle and does not introduce an omitted quotation.
Retain the prayer to keep the promise and the quoted conditional succession assurance. Thou/Thy address God in the frame; ordinary you/your address David inside God's remembered speech.
Retain the request that the spoken utterance be confirmed and indeed as the emphatic particle's force. David remains explicitly the named servant.

Retain God's dwelling with humans, heaven and singular heaven of heaven insufficient for Thee, and the question about this house. Do not import how much less or add an unexpressed for Thee to the final building clause.
Retain prayer and supplication, the repeated listening request and today. The future-shaped Greek petition is rendered as an English request in context; no guaranteed automatic answer is claimed.
Retain open eyes day and night toward the house and place where the name is invoked, and repeated prayer toward this place. Day/night order is selected and not reversed to a familiar formula.

Retain servant and Israel's supplication, prayer toward the place, heavenly dwelling and repeated hearing followed by being propitious. The temple is the direction of prayer, not a replacement for the heavenly dwelling.
column3: Propitious remains a provisional lexical choice; whether forgive best conveys this formula without narrowing it requires review.

column2: Retain sin against a neighbor, taking an oath-curse and coming to swear before the altar. No particular lawsuit verdict is supplied before the next petition.
column3: The subject of taking and the force of the oath/curse construction remain unresolved; the inherited self-binding interpretation is not an independent legal reconstruction.

column2: Retain hearing, action, judgment, return of the lawless man's ways upon his head and vindication of the righteous according to righteousness. The opposed outcomes and both repayment expressions remain.
Retain defeat before the enemy, the repeated if relation to sin, return, confession, prayer and supplication in the house. The selected second conditional is not silently changed into because.
Retain heavenly hearing, propitiousness toward Israel's sins and return to the land given to them and their fathers. The land's two recipient groups remain explicit.
Retain closed heaven, no rain, their future sin and God's future humbling, with prayer, praise and turning. Do not convert all selected futures into completed past acts.

Propose in which they will walk in place of in which they should walk. The selected relative clause has a future indicative, not an explicit obligation modal. This keeps the anticipated walking alongside Thou wilt make known, while the surrounding prayer requests remain. Preserve servants, Israel, rain and inherited land; the close stage retains should.

Retain famine, death, wind damage, yellowing, locust and consuming locust, enemy oppression before cities and every plague and suffering. Do not merge the two insect terms or substitute an unexpressed city gate.
column3: Yellowing and the distinction between the locust terms remain lexical questions; no exact modern pest or crop disease is asserted.

column2: Retain every prayer and supplication, individual and collective Israel, knowledge of personal affliction and weakness and hands spread toward the house. The wording does not claim a single shared illness for the whole people.
Retain the prepared heavenly dwelling, propitiousness and each man's recompense according to ways and known heart. Alone is explicit in the selected statement of divine heart knowledge.
Retain fear of Thy ways throughout life on the ancestral land. Do not replace ways with Thee or add a separate walking-in-ways clause to match another witness.
Retain every foreigner outside Israel, distant origin, great name, mighty hand and uplifted arm. The selected shift from singular foreigner to plural they come and pray remains visible.

Retain hearing from the prepared dwelling, everything the foreigner invokes, and all peoples knowing and fearing the name as Israel does. The final name-called-over-house clause remains without making the foreigner an Israelite first.
Retain war against enemies by the way God sends and prayer toward the chosen city and name-house. The selected condition is not broadened into approval of any military campaign.
Retain hearing supplication and prayer and upholding their right. The judicial expression is not replaced with an explicit promise to win the battle.

Retain future sin, the universal parenthetical future about human sin, God's striking and handing over, and captors taking them far or near. Do not soften strike into anger or omit either distance alternative.

Retain turning the heart in the land of deportation, renewed return and entreaty, and the threefold confession of sin, wrong and lawlessness. Their land remains the selected possessive even in the exile setting.
column3: The possessive's antecedent and the conditional force of the continuing clauses remain open; no captors' land substitution is imposed here.

column2: Retain whole heart and soul, the captors' land and prayer toward their own land, chosen city and built house. The three objects of direction remain rather than being compressed to Jerusalem alone.
Retain prepared heavenly dwelling, prayer and supplication, plural judgments and propitiousness toward the sinning people. No further request for compassion from captors is imported from Kings.
Retain open eyes and attentive ears to this place's supplication. I beseech Thee is an inherited rendering of the entreating particle, not a separately expressed first-person beseech verb.

Retain divine rising to rest with the ark of strength, priests clothing themselves with salvation and Thy sons rejoicing in good things. Four poetic lines follow the selected clauses; sons is not harmonized to saints.

Retain the request not to turn away the anointed one's face and remembrance of David's mercies. Two lines preserve the paired petitions; no one-sided interpretation of mercies given to or exercised by David is inserted.
column3: The genitive relation in mercies of David remains open; the reading does not establish a single theological interpretation.
